Expense approval flowchart

From receipt to reimbursement, with two decisions: whether the expense follows the policy and whether it is over the threshold that needs a second approval.

Open this flow in the editor Free, no sign-up. Opens as a new diagram in your browser.
The flow: Expense approval
Interactive diagram: drag to pan, scroll to zoom. Changes made here are not saved.

How to read the flow

  1. The employee pays the expense and submits the claim with the receipt.
  2. The manager checks that it is within policy and budget.
  3. If it is not, the manager rejects it with a reason; the employee corrects it and submits again.
  4. Finance checks the amount: over 500 EUR needs a second approval from the finance lead.
  5. The reimbursement is scheduled in the next payroll run and the employee receives the money.

The text behind the diagram

This is what Diagramico exports under Export → AI text. It also works the other way round: paste this text into Diagrams → Import text and the diagram is drawn.

DIAGRAM: Expense approval

LANES:
EM = Employee (person)
MG = Manager (person)
FI = Finance (department)

NODES:
EM1 start: Pays an expense
EM2 user_action: Submits the claim with the receipt
MG1 decision: Within policy and budget?
MG2 step: Rejects it and gives the reason
EM3 user_action: Corrects it and submits again
FI1 decision: Over 500 EUR?
FI2 step: Second approval by the finance lead
FI3 step: Schedules the reimbursement in the next payroll run
EM4 end: Receives the reimbursement

FLOW:
EM1 > EM2 > MG1
MG1 > FI1 [yes]
MG1 > MG2 [no]
MG2 > EM3 > MG1
FI1 > FI2 [yes]
FI1 > FI3 [no]
FI2 > FI3 > EM4

Ask an AI

Each button copies the request together with the flow text. Paste it into the assistant you use.

Documentation

Write the documentation of this process for the people who will run it: purpose, who takes part, numbered steps by owner and what happens at each decision. Use only what is in the flow and point out anything that is not defined.

Test cases

List the test cases for this process as a table: scenario, starting condition, steps and expected result. Cover every branch of every decision, including the ones that loop back.

Review the logic

Review the logic of this process. Point out decisions with no way out, loops that may never end, steps with no clear owner and cases the flow does not handle. Do not rewrite the process: list the problems by severity.

Adapt it to your case

  • Change the 500 EUR threshold in the decision to the value in your policy.
  • If you use an expenses tool, add a system lane and connect it with dashed arrows (data access).
  • Add a branch for expenses without a receipt, which is the case that raises most questions.
